title: 5-Layer Expanded Stack with Widened Search Bounds
scientific_hypothesis: Adding a fifth dielectric layer provides additional interference degrees of freedom to suppress residual visible reflectance while maintaining IR reflectance, and widened thickness bounds (±8 nm for Layer 1, ±10 nm for Layer 3) escape the narrow optimization basin that limited previous 4-layer iterations.
design_principle: Metal-dielectric multilayer with expanded layer count and broader initial thickness exploration to find deeper local minima in the spectral selectivity objective landscape.
proposed_topology: Air | SiO2 | Cr | HfO2 | SiO2 | Al substrate (5 finite layers)
manufacturing_considerations: Cr layer thickness constrained for adhesion and absorption balance
theory_basis: Admittance locus method for metal-dielectric multilayer optimization
Five-step structured design procedure for optical thin films
expected_advantages: Additional interference stage for visible band suppression
Wider search bounds escape local minima from 4-layer iterations
Maintains material compatibility with prior routes
known_risks: Increased layer count may reduce robustness
Wider bounds may increase optimization iterations needed
execution_request_english: Optimize a 5-layer spectrally selective absorber stack on aluminum substrate with sequence: SiO2 | Cr | HfO2 | SiO2 | SiO2 (air incidence). Wavelength bands: 400-700 nm maximize absorptance, 700-2000 nm maximize reflectance. Layer thickness bounds: Layer1 SiO2 60-76 nm (±8 nm around 68 nm baseline), Layer2 Cr 28-36 nm, Layer3 HfO2 230-250 nm (±10 nm around 240 nm baseline), Layer4 SiO2 50-150 nm, Layer5 SiO2 50-150 nm. Use gradient and differential evolution optimizers. Normal incidence, unpolarized illumination. Registry-resolved materials HfO2, SiO2, Cr. Total finite layer count: 5. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 400-700 nm, 700-2000 nm. soft objectives: high absorptance in 400-700 nm; low reflectance in 400-700 nm; high reflectance in 700-2000 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high reflectance in 400-700 nm; high absorptance in 700-2000 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count not exceeding 20.
revision_reason: Following insight appendage directive to widen thickness search bounds for Layer 1 and Layer 3, and expand layer count from 4 to 5 to test additional dielectric stage for visible reflectance suppression.
